tasks.brief: Edit src/services/models.py. Remove the module-level constant `ROUTER_MODEL_ID`. Update `router_models()`: when VORTEX_URL is unset return []; otherwise probe GET {base}/v1/models with httpx.get(base + "/v1/models", timeout=5). On non-200 or exception return []. On 200, parse the JSON `data` array and return a list of `{"id": <id>, "source": "router"}` for every entry in probe order, deduplicated (first occurrence wins). Update `is_router_model(model_id)`: return True iff `model_id` is in the live probe set (same shared probe as router_models); False on probe failure or when VORTEX_URL is unset. Keep `is_router_configured()` and `router_chat_endpoint()` unchanged. Ensure `list_models()` still appends `router_models()` after the LM Studio block and before the SCRIPT_MODELS loop. Acceptance: no fixed router model id exists; router_models returns the full ready set; is_router_model uses dynamic membership; probe timeout is 5s.

No code change. The delta touches none of its behavior. Self-verify: confirm no working-tree change to this file; the pinned regression tests pass untouched.

Edit src/api/chat.py. Inside the existing `if request.model:` block, after the script-model branch and before the `endpoint_override = None` fall-through, replace the current router gate with: `elif models_mod.is_router_configured() and models_mod.is_router_model(request.model):` then set `endpoint_override = models_mod.router_chat_endpoint()`. Do NOT raise 422 for not-ready models; they fall through to the local path. In the SSE generator's exception handler, if the error is message-less and the request was router-routed, re-probe via `models_mod.is_router_model(request.model)`; if False, emit the exact not-ready message `Model {id} is not ready in Vortex. Pick a local model or retry once it is loaded.` as a 200 SSE error event; if True, keep the generic fallback. Acceptance: router routes any ready model; not-ready falls through; 404 race surfaces not-ready message; still-ready error keeps generic fallback.
